// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The school-scope permission is for the pupil headcount the price band needs
// and for nothing else. The same traversal counting children's work is a figure
// R10 never asked for, so it is still refused.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function itemsInSchool(schoolId) {
  return db.journalItem.count({ where: { class: { teacher: { schoolId } } } });
}
